Installed: the reconstructed head-word, part of speech, glosses, the Proto-Indo-European ancestor the article asserts, the Sanskrit/Avestan/Proto-Iranian/Proto-Nuristani witnesses cited in the etymology sidecar, and the scholarly works the article credits.
